title: Commander Response
description: The frontmatter of a commander response (CR): a written enacted approval against a pilot request or other pilot record, held frozen and verbatim once written. May stand alone as its own file, or be written internally inside the pilot's own record, in which case it stays frozen there and is also extracted here so it is on record; only the orders, advice and questions a CR contains are extracted elsewhere, the CR text itself never moves. Filed by identifier with a dash, CR-004.md.

type.description: the words Commander Response, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this response's identifier, CR, a dash and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

context.description: the identifiers this response answers, a bracketed list: the pilot request or other pilot record it enacts approval against. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

generates.description: the identifiers of the orders, advice and questions extracted out of this response's text, a bracketed list; the CR itself is never one of them
